verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's app/PWA is not gated behind a login wall (hoppscotch-comm-1) and offers a desktop app, suggesting offline use is possible, but hands-on community testing found offline mode is limited to a single workspace with no way to point data to a local directory like competitor Bruno (hoppscotch-comm-2), undermining a full offline local-workspace story. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing local/offline workspace directory support, and resolution of the reported offline workspace limitations.
